entries.title: Course registration closes
entries.summary: Semester V course registration closes at 5:00 PM. Late registration needs advisor approval.

entries.title: Attendance eligibility rule
entries.summary: Students need at least 75 percent attendance in each course to be eligible for end-semester exams.

entries.title: Scholarship renewal forms
entries.summary: Merit scholarship renewal forms must be submitted through the student portal before midnight.

entries.title: Mid-semester exam timetable
entries.summary: The revised mid-semester timetable is available in the academics office and student portal.

entries.title: Library fine and book issue policy
entries.summary: Standard book issue duration is 14 days. Late returns are charged at 5 INR per day per book.

entries.title: Project submission format
entries.summary: Final project submissions must include source code, README, architecture notes, test evidence, and a demo video link.

entries.title: Minor project progress review
entries.summary: Semester V project teams must submit their progress presentation and working prototype report to the department.

entries.title: Online course credit approval
entries.summary: Students seeking approval for MOOC course credits must submit certificates and learning plans before 4:00 PM.

entries.title: Backlog examination registration
entries.summary: Backlog exam applications and fee payments must be completed through the student portal.

entries.title: Revaluation request process
entries.summary: Revaluation requests are accepted for seven working days after result publication and require a fee per subject.

entries.title: Departmental lab inventory check
entries.summary: Laboratory in-charges will verify hardware, software licenses, and safety equipment before the semester closure.

entries.title: Winter vacation travel declaration
entries.summary: Hostel residents planning to leave campus during winter break must complete the travel declaration form.

entries.title: Laptop and device security policy
entries.summary: Campus Wi-Fi and laboratory networks require device registration, updated antivirus software, and approved security settings.

entries.title: End-semester practical schedule
entries.summary: Laboratory practical timetables will be published by department coordinators one week before the examinations.
